name: joey-award-visual-director
title_zh: 没学过设计也能排出证书级海报的视觉总监
tagline_zh: 你只给活动名和一句主题，它替你定字号层级、留白比例和背景图，最后交出的东西像请了设计师。不用懂网格。
tagline_en: Give it an event name and one line of theme; it sets type scale, whitespace and background art, and hands back.
desc_en: Guide beginners to create certificate-style posters and event key visuals with clear typography, intentional whitespace, and generated background imagery. Use when someone wants a polished award certificate, hero poster, or similar visual but lacks design experience.
why_zh: 它先定版式骨架再生成背景图，而不是先挑图再硬塞文字，所以字永远压得住画面。
why_en: It locks the layout skeleton before generating background art, so the type always sits on top of the image instead of fighting it.
limit_zh: 只做证书、主视觉这类单页静态图，不做多页画册和动态视频；背景图靠生成模型。
limit_en: Single-page static only (certificates, key visuals) — no multi-page decks or video. Generated backgrounds may contain garbled text or logos; rerun.
